name: Re.verse ~Kioku~
source:
Main character loses his job and follows a newspaper vacation for a vaguely depicted job. The next day he is picked up by woman Kaoru and taken to a mansion where he needs to overcome girl Elena's phobia of men.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角丢了工作，看到报纸上的招聘启事，便应聘了一份说明含糊的职位。第二天，一位名叫薰的女子接走他，把他带到一栋宅邸；他的任务是帮助少女叶莲娜克服男性恐惧症。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
